description: Header file defining structures, enums, constants, and includes related to audio effects bundling and virtualizer effects in Android's media framework.

classes.name: PresetConfig
classes.description: Configuration for audio effect presets, including a human-readable name.

classes.name: BundledEffectContext
classes.description: Context for a bundled audio effect session, storing effect states and parameters.

classes.name: SessionContext
classes.description: Represents a session with flags indicating which effects are enabled and instantiated.

classes.name: EffectContext
classes.description: General context for an effect, including interface, configuration, and type.
